jobs.description:
For the development of our core strategic solutions, we are currently looking for a very experienced, top motivated, hands-on:

TECHNICAL COORDINATOR (SOFTWARE / AUTOMATION)

The Technical Coordinator is responsible for coordinating and driving the validation of industrial software and/or automation solutions for our coding machines. The role combines strong technical expertise, delivery accountability, and cross-functional coordination, ensuring predictable execution, high quality, and continuous improvement of both processes and solutions.

Role :

• Drive coordination Software release validation for our industrial inhouse coding machines.

• Plan, coordinate, and monitor validation and release activities for customer-specific customizations.

• Actively manage planning, risks, technical dependencies, and delivery constraints, taking corrective actions through replanning, reprioritization, or mitigation when required.

• Solve technical dependencies with people in development teams, QA, deployment teams and operations. Assure availability of machines and material for validation.

• Plan and execute validation assuring operational readiness of coding machines at expected quality on the committed deadlines. Incorporate risks, constraints and dependencies into planning to be able to commit to a delivery date.

• Maintain a structured and transparent status of all ongoing validation activities.

• Manage and follow up on incidents, problems, and change requests raised from operations or field technicians.

• Improve internal validation process and tooling for release validation.

• Promote and apply a continuous improvement mindset, simplifying processes, validation approaches, and technical solutions to improve efficiency, robustness, and time-to‑market.

• Actively contribute to the technical development and evolution of industrial solutions.

• Support activities both in the office and in the field, including validation, commissioning, and operational support when required.

Profile :

• Bachelor’s or master’s degree in a technical field (Software Engineering, Computer Science, Automation, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent).

• Minimum 5 years of experience in industrial or technical environments involving complex systems.

• Strong hands-on expertise in at least one of the following domains:

•

• Java software development (industrial software, platforms, backend or custom applications)

• Industrial automation / PLC programming (e.g. Siemens, Rockwell, Schneider, or equivalent).

• Good technical understanding of both software and automation domains, enabling effective coordination across multidisciplinary teams.

• Proven experience in delivery-driven environments, managing timelines, priorities, dependencies, and risks.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills are key, with the ability to align stakeholders, facilitate collaboration, handle priorities, and address issues constructively.

• Ability to take a step back and maintain a global overview while remaining pragmatic and solution oriented.

• Comfortable working both in the office and on-site (support, validation, commissioning, troubleshooting).

• Proactive, reliable, and results-oriented, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

• Curious and improvement-driven, continuously seeking to simplify processes and solutions.

• Fluent in English; French is a plus; additional European languages are an asset.

• Willingness to travel internationally when required

•

• Entwicklung von Java-Software (Industriesoftware, Plattformen, Backend oder benutzerdefinierte Anwendungen)

jobs.description:
Chemist – Machine-Readable Features Laboratory

The Chemist is a technical contributor within the Machine Readable Features Laboratory, supporting the research, development, formulation, characterization, and validation of machine-readable features used for authentication and traceability applications. The role covers a broad portfolio of security technologies, including functional materials, pigments, inks, and associated measurement methods (optical, physical, chemical, and functional), and combines hands on laboratory work, ink formulation, and experimental characterization in close collaboration within the whole department.

This position is well suited for an early career chemist seeking to build strong technical depth, autonomy, and industrial expertise, with clear progression toward senior role.
 ROLE:

• Contribute to the research, development and optimization of security features, including materials, pigments, and ink systems for machine readable and authentication applications.

• Perform ink formulation work, including dispersion, stability optimization, and performance evaluation on various substrates.

• Support the integration of functional security materials into different ink platforms and printing processes.

• Design and execute laboratory experiments to evaluate feature performance, robustness, and reproducibility.

• Perform measurements and characterization using a wide range of laboratory equipment (e.g. optical, physical, chemical, functional, or instrumental techniques, not limited to IR/optics).

• Participate in the validation of new materials, methods, and processes, contributing to industrial readiness.

• Analyze experimental data, interpret results, and propose technical improvements.

• Draft technical reports, experimental summaries, and presentations for internal R&D stakeholders.

• Contribute to technical documentation, including Technical Data Sheets (TDS), feature descriptions, and internal protocols.

• Support printing trials and customer-related activities, under guidance of senior staff.

• Actively collaborate within multidisciplinary project teams (chemistry, optics, electronics, software).

PROFILE:

• Swiss Federal Certificate (CFC/EFZ) in Chemical Laboratory Technology with minimum 7 year of relevant experience,or

• Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, or equivalent (no prior industrial experience required).

• Strong interest and/or initial experience in ink formulation and functional materials.

• Hands-on laboratory mindset with experience (or strong aptitude) in using measurement and characterization equipment across different techniques.

• Ability to design experiments, follow protocols, and ensure data quality and traceability.

• Comfortable using Microsoft Office tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) for documentation and data analysis.

• Personal Skills & Senior Skill Potential.

• Curious, motivated, and eager to develop deep technical expertise.

• Strong analytical and problem solving mindset.

• Increasingly autonomous, with the ability to manage laboratory tasks with limited supervision.

• Reliable, structured, and quality oriented.

• Team player in a multicultural and interdisciplinary environment.

• Willingness to progressively take on broader responsibilities (technical ownership, documentation quality, cross team interactions).

• Good working knowledge of English and French (spoken and written).

JOIN US !

• Our success comes from our highly skilled and talented employees.

• Respectful entrepreneurship and long-term vision are key for success.

• Our people contribute to a more secure world.

• Diversity at all levels of an organisation is a strength.

We offer an exciting and challenging role, with great potential for personal development within a unique organization in a fascinating and fast-growing industry. Your file will be handled with upmost confidentiality and discretion.

Quality & Integrated Management System Specialist

The Q&IMS Specialist will report to the Global IMS Lead and will be responsible for supporting the strategic development, implementation, and maintenance of SICPA’s Integrated Management System (IMS) and related activities.

ROLE:

• Coordinate SICPA’s IMS activities across more than 20 sites worldwide.

• Maintain and control process mapping and system documentation, ensuring accuracy and compliance with quality standards.

• Provide support and training to business process owners and IMS officers on ISO standards and the SICPA Group Integrated Management System, ensuring compliance with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, ISO 37001, ISO 27001, and others.

• Support the deployment and expansion of the IMS to newly acquired or established sites, ensuring full alignment with corporate standards.

• Collaborate with auditors on Process Compliance Assessments (PCAs) and internal audits, acting as auditor or team leader to ensure consistent application of standards and continuous improvement across all sites.

• Coordinate external ISO certification audits and provide support during customer audits.

• Manage external IMS-related suppliers, including consultants and certification bodies.

• Oversee and support migration of IMS-related IT tools, including the Document Control System, iGrafx for process mapping, and BPA for managing audits, non-conformities, and improvement actions.

• Manage and coordinate customer’s process-related questionnaires, satisfaction surveys and annual reviews.

• Promote a strong quality culture throughout the organization.

PROFILE:

• University degree in quality management, engineering, business administration, or a related field.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in quality systems and integrated management systems, preferably within companies operating in multiple countries.

• Certified Implementer in at least one of the standards ISO 9001, 14001, 45001, or 27001, and preferably also a certified lead auditor.

• Proven experience leading ISO certification programs (e.g., ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001), ideally in a multiple-site structure.Experience managing internal audits and third-party assessments.

• Proficiency in IMS tools and documentation control systems.

• Familiarity with automation and data analytics tools, such Power Automate and Power BI, is highly valued.

• Excellent organizational and project management skills.

• Exceptional communication skills with the ability to engage and influence stakeholders at all levels.

• High attention to detail and commitment to continuous improvement.

• Strong emotional intelligence with ability to work effectively in cross-functional & multicultural teams.

• Fluency in English is required and proficiency in French would be appreciated.
